answer: Random peer audit keeps the economy honest. Each epoch a beacon picks three peers to replay an agent's work and check signatures, like climbers on a narrow ridge, every step watched. A $40 deposit locks in a vault for 12 epochs; a failed audit burns it and freezes the agent 5 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000 for nothing, while a glacier-slow history can't be faked overnight. An honest agent pays $40 once and keeps full earnings.
